notes: Fiscal year ended September 29, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Sep 2024'). Financial figures are from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000804328-24-000075) and match SEC XBRL. Ownership is from the proxy for the March 2025 annual meeting (DEF 14A filed January 23, 2025, accession 0001104659-25-005602), percentages based on 1,106,603,064 shares outstanding on December 15, 2024. LEADER: Irwin M. Jacobs, co-founder, is not a current director, nominee or named executive officer and is not listed as a 5% holder, so no holding is reported. HOLDERS: Vanguard's figure refers to May 31, 2024 and BlackRock's to December 31, 2023, as the proxy footnotes state. GEOGRAPHY: from fiscal 2024 Qualcomm presents revenue by the headquarters location of the customer or licensee, not where devices are sold. The 10-K adds that on a delivery-location basis China (including Hong Kong), the United States, South Korea and Vietnam were 66%, 3%, 7% and 12% of fiscal 2024 revenue. BUYBACKS exclude $932 million of tax withholdings on vesting share awards.
